question: Which country won the 4th Asian Kho-Kho Championship 2023 event in the Men's category?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India won the **4th Asian Kho-Kho Championship 2023** in the Men's category, held in **Tamulpur, Assam**.
 
• The Indian men's team defeated **Nepal** in the finals to secure the championship title.
 
• The event featured **participation from 12 countries**, showcasing competitive matches throughout the tournament.
 
• India displayed exceptional skill and teamwork, reinforcing its dominance in the sport of Kho-Kho.
 
• This victory further strengthens India's position as a leading nation in traditional sports such as Kho-Kho.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kho-Kho** is a traditional Indian sport known for its fast-paced nature and emphasis on agility, teamwork, and strategy.
 
• The sport is played between two teams, with players alternating between chasing (defenders) and running (attackers).
 
• The **Asian Kho-Kho Federation** governs the sport at the continental level and organizes championships like the Asian Kho-Kho Championship.
 
• Kho-Kho is gaining international recognition and is being promoted as part of India's efforts to popularize indigenous sports globally.
 
• The 4th Asian Kho-Kho Championship 2023 was hosted in **India** to further boost the visibility and development of the sport.
